Definition: probably from G3047; Libye, a region of Africa:--Libya.
BiblicalUsage: Libýē means Libya, a region of Africa — a small word with a sharp edge. In Acts 2:10, "and in the parts of Libya about Cyrene".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Libya on the Pentecost list is the promise — Jews and proselytes from Africa heard the gospel in their own tongue on the first day.
